summary.text: The Department of Justice announced the formation of a Super Intelligence Task Force to address misuse of SI by foreign and criminal actors and to promote American SI dominance. The Department has said it will seek stronger sentences when AI is abused to make corporate crime more serious and has described AI-generated child sexual abuse material as causing substantial harm. DOJ has described AI as a double-edged tool with potential to help identify and disrupt threats, while also establishing internal coordination bodies and initiatives to govern its use. DOJ enforcement examples in the supplied evidence include charges over illegal export of AI-capable GPUs and a non-prosecution agreement in an AI-enabled Medicare fraud scheme.

statements.text: The U.S. Department of Justice is announcing the formation of its Super Intelligence (SI) Task Force (DOJ-SITF). President Trump has made clear that “America stands at the forefront of a new technological revolution in intelligence,” and the Department will be a leader in safeguarding against malicious SI actors.

statements.text: I hereby establish the Department of Justice Super Intelligence Task Force (DOJ-SITF). The DOJ-SITF will ensure that America's leadership in SI is not compromised by the misuse of SI by foreign state and state-sponsored actors, transnational criminal organizations, and individual or corporate actors engaged in fraud or other unlawful conduct.
